uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Overgrow
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When HP is low, increases all damage dealt. When HP is 30% or less; increase all damage dealt by 20%.
passiveEffects.summary: When HP is low, increases all damage dealt. When HP is 30% or less; increase all damage dealt by 20%.
notes: timing, stacking overflow, refresh behavior, and rounding are unconfirmed unless explicitly stated

normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also pulls enemies inward between the vines. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, becoming a vine whip that strikes twice, pulls enemies between both vines, and stuns them for 0.4s, then applies a 20% slow for 1.5s.

moveEffects.name: Seed Bomb
moveEffects.originalDescription: Hurl a large seed at the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Venusaur hurls a large seed to the designated location, damaging all enemies in the radius.

moveEffects.name: Razor Leaf
moveEffects.originalDescription: Launch many sharp-edged leaves in a quick succession of attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Venusaur launches a barrage of sharp-edged leaves in the designated direction, damaging enemies 10 times over 0.75s.
moveEffects.summary: Launch many sharp-edged leaves in a quick succession of attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Venusaur launches a barrage of sharp-edged leaves in the designated direction, damaging enemies 10 times over 0.75s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Verdant Anger
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Launches a giant seed toward the designated area. The seed then splits apart, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. Venusaur becomes unstoppable to hurl a massive seed to the designated location, damaging all enemies in the radius and slowing them by 35% for 1s. The seed then splits apart into 4 smaller seeds, each damaging all enemies in their radius. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
